Tips
Epic Mournlode Shortsword (edit) Short Sword
  • Upgradeable - Tier 1Upgradeable - Tier 1: This item is a Tier 1 upgradable item.
    • +5 Enhancement Bonus+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
    • RighteousRighteous: This weapon is imbued with holy power, giving it an additional +2 to attack bonus and damage against any evil creature. This power makes the weapon good-aligned.
    • Undead Bane 4Undead Bane 4: Those that have died must return, and this weapon is attuned specifically to lay them to rest. This weapon deals an additional 4d10 bane damage vs. Undead.
    • BrillianceBrilliance: This weapon glows with the light of Irian. This weapon deals an extra 1d61 to 6 light damage on a successful hit. In addition, critical hits deal an additional 1d101 to 10 light damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2d102 to 20 for a x3 critical multiplier and 3d103 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.
    • Radiant BlastRadiant Blast: This weapon stores the power of the plane of Irian deep within. Occasionally, this dynamic power comes to the surface, devastating enemies with a massive blast of radiant light.
  • Upgradeable - Tier 2Upgradeable - Tier 2: This item is a Tier 2 upgradable item.
    • +5 Enhancement Bonus+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls. → +6 Enhancement Bonus+6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
    • Undead Bane 4Undead Bane 4: Those that have died must return, and this weapon is attuned specifically to lay them to rest. This weapon deals an additional 4d10 bane damage vs. Undead. → Undead Bane 5Undead Bane 5: Those that have died must return, and this weapon is attuned specifically to lay them to rest. This weapon deals an additional 5d10 bane damage vs. Undead.
    • Adds Colorless Augment SlotColorless
  • Upgradeable - Tier 3Upgradeable - Tier 3: This item is a Tier 3 upgradable item.
    • Adds Blinding FlashBlinding Flash: This weapon glows with a white radiance. If you roll a 20 when attacking and confirm the critical hit, the target will become blinded by a burst of high-intensity light.
    • Adds Purple Augment SlotBlue, Purple, Red, and/or Colorless
 20 Bound to Account on Acquire Vaults of the Artificers, various challenge ingredients
